headline: Nestoil Repays $100 Million of Bank Debt Following Anti-Corruption Intervention
summary: Nigerian oil firm Nestoil has repaid $100 million of a $1 billion debt owed to a consortium of banks following intervention by the country's anti-corruption agency.
why: Nestoil is a prominent Nigerian oil and gas engineering and exploration company with substantial credit exposures to major domestic financial institutions. Debt servicing updates provide insight into energy sector leverage and banking asset quality.

impacts.name: Nestoil
impacts.why: Repaying a portion of outstanding debt reduces leverage for the private oil firm.
